title: Scalable linearized gate set tomography
summary: Characterizing errors on many-qubit quantum computers remains a key challenge to understanding and improving the performance of these devices. Current characterization methods either don't scale beyond a few qubits, or make simplifying assumptions (such as assuming stochastic Pauli error) that obscure the underlying physical error mechanisms. In this work, we present a scalable extension to gate set tomography-linearized gate set tomography-that enables characterization of many-qubit systems.
